turns.content: A fixed amount of nitrogen is held in a rigid vessel and treated as a perfect gas. With n and V constant, how does its pressure depend on absolute temperature?
Write a relation connecting an initial electronic eigenstate (p_1,T_1) and a final state (p_2,T_2), then solve it symbolically for p_2.
A sample of solid diamond enters a constant-volume vessel at 100 atm and 300 K and is heated to 500 K. Substitute these values into the perfect-gas expression for p_2.
Evaluate the expression and explain whether the working pressure should be above or below the entry pressure.
Check that direction physically in terms of molecular collisions with the walls of a constant-volume vessel.
Check the units and the order of magnitude of the calculated pressure.
Report the working pressure to one decimal place and to the nearest atmosphere.
